resources.string: Silent MP4 live wallpapers that play forward and backward. Your video stays on your device.
Choose an MP4 file from your device. The app keeps access to this file using Android’s document picker.
Choose a video to calculate its colors.
The sampled colors are provided to Android as wallpaper colors. The system decides how and when to apply them to its theme.
Reading a few frames to calculate the wallpaper colors…
Video selected. Preview it and choose where to set the wallpaper.
Could not read this video. Choose a supported MP4 file and try again.
Could not save the video selection. Please try again.
Android did not grant lasting access to this file. Please choose it again from the system file picker.
No compatible system file picker was found.
The wallpaper will stop using the selected video and its calculated colors.
Play a selected MP4 forward and backward as a live wallpaper, and share its sampled colors with Android.
